name: auth-failure
description: A revoked or mistyped API token. The very first call (/version) answers 401, and every other endpoint would answer the same way. Proves the run stops immediately with a printed credential diagnostic naming the PVEAPIToken form, reports zero assets, and never walks the cluster printing the same error per node - the difference between 'the token was refused' and what used to be a silent 'reported 0 assets' with no explanation, indistinguishable from an empty cluster.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

log_contains: could not read the PVE version: status 401
the API token was refused; check the token id user@realm!tokenid and its secret
